$comment: Onboard Automation Bridge — config reference. The extension stores these in chrome.storage.local; the popup's 'Email & Storage Config' panel is the UI. The v3-mail defaults below SHIP pre-filled (the popup falls back to them when a key was never saved), so a fresh install runs the email presets with zero configuration. The v3-mail worker API (https://v3-mail.priv.email) returns FULL EMAIL BODIES via Bearer auth — use a NAMED priv.email alias (admin@ by default) so mail dual-delivers into the worker. For catch-all addresses (metadata/subject-only) swap in the ImprovMX logs endpoint + Basic pair instead. This file is documentation — the extension does not read it. For automation, set the same keys via chrome.storage.local.
$serverUrl: (optional) ws://127.0.0.1:3000 for the local dev daemon, or wss://<your-preview-host>/ in the sandbox — set via the popup's Server Connection box, not here
$authToken: (optional) only if the daemon was started with --token
